Application Data.NAME: Java Bean Coffee Co.
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Brew Street, Suite 100, Coffee City, CA 90210-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Java Bean Coffee Co. operates a cozy coffee shop and tea house offering a wide selection of high-quality coffee and loose-leaf teas. Our establishment spans 2,500 square feet with seating for up to 60 patrons, creating an intimate atmosphere for our customers. We are dedicated to maintaining a year-round operation without seasonal closures, ensuring consistent service and risk management. We do not serve alcohol or provide live entertainment, minimizing liability exposure. Our staff undergoes thorough background checks, and we have implemented strict internal controls to mitigate risks associated with employee theft. Additionally, we prioritize fire safety with regular inspections and training for all employees, ensuring a safe environment for both patrons and staff.

Application Data.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Java Bean Coffee Co. operates a second coffee shop location at 456 Mocha Lane, Brewtown, CA 90211-1234, under the name "Java Bean Express." This location specializes in quick-service coffee and pastries, with seating for 30 patrons and a total area of 1,200 square feet. The shop has been operational since 06/01/2021 and follows the same risk management protocols for employee background checks and fire safety as the main location. There is no alcohol service or live entertainment at this site.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2022, a small fire broke out in the storage area due to an electrical malfunction, causing damage to equipment and inventory. The estimated loss amount was $5,000. The fire department responded promptly, and the incident was resolved with no injuries reported. The situation has since been addressed, and all safety measures have been reinforced. The claim was filed, and the status is closed with full reimbursement received on 06/10/2022.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: B Rate Class - UL Listed, Grade A, 2-Hour Fire Rated, Secured by Central Station Alarm
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols conducted daily and surveillance cameras installed throughout the premises.
